column2: A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties (short gray-streaked hair, reading glasses on a cord) and a Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties (dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt) sit at a small café table, an open notebook of handwritten notes between them, discussing an idea with interest

Night, a small accounting office in southern Brazil. A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked short hair and reading glasses scrolls on her phone through an app store full of nearly identical app icons (icons shown as blurred colored squares), a desk lamp and neat folders behind her, thoughtful expression

A physiotherapy clinic in Recife. A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, patiently demonstrates a knee exercise for the tenth time to a middle-aged patient on crutches, other patients in the background

A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked short hair and reading glasses compares, on a laptop, two app screens that look almost identical side by side (screens shown as blurred abstract shapes), slightly unimpressed expression, office with folders

A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, holds a patient's phone and looks at it with the patient, an older woman, in a clinic waiting area; the phone screen shows only blurred colored shapes

Early morning, a Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked short hair and reading glasses sits at her kitchen table with a cup of coffee and an open paper notebook, writing calmly, soft window light

A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, sits at a laptop in a small clinic office, a paper notepad beside him divided into two columns of handwritten notes (illegible), focused

A small accounting office in southern Brazil. A cheerful Brazilian woman in her sixties, a home baker with an apron, arrives with a paper shopping bag overflowing with receipts and papers; a Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked hair and reading glasses receives her across the desk

A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, fills out a tall pile of paper discharge forms at a clinic desk, bored expression, pen in hand, afternoon light

A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked short hair and reading glasses reads news on her phone (screen shown as blurred shapes) standing by her office window, pensive, city of Joinville with modest buildings outside

A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, carefully adjusts the knee of a patient lying on a treatment table, precise hands, attentive expression, clinic room

A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked hair and reading glasses, holding a folder, visits a client in a small metalworking shop in Brazil, among machines and a few sparks, the owner in work clothes talking to her

Morning in a simple Brazilian home in Recife. An older Brazilian man in his late sixties does a gentle knee exercise on a chair in the living room, his phone propped on a bookshelf showing blurred shapes, sunlight through the window

A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked hair and reading glasses sits on her living room sofa in the evening, reading a busy group conversation on her phone (screen blurred), a small smile

A clinic corridor in Recife. A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, talks with a female physiotherapist colleague in her forties, both holding tablets, friendly exchange

A small accounting office counter in southern Brazil. A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked hair and reading glasses explains something with a simple hand gesture to a young female client who listens and nods

A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, holds a stopwatch while an older Brazilian man in his late sixties uses a smartphone for the first time at a clinic table, concentrating

A Brazilian accountant woman in her early fifties with gray-streaked hair and reading glasses watches on her laptop an anonymous recording of someone using a website (screen shown as blurred shapes and a cursor), pen in hand, taking notes on paper

A Brazilian physiotherapist man in his late thirties, dark skin, short beard, clinic polo shirt, reads three different notes on his laptop screen (blurred), a printed document beside him with handwritten marks, evening in a small clinic office, thoughtful
